title: Data story stat
description: One finding from Massive research, its number big and a dot chart of it: one dot per item in the total, the finding's share lit red. Source: https://www.joinmassive.com/blog/edpb-web-scraping-guidelines (Massive's robots.txt check of 47 news sites, October 26, 2026: 42 block at least one AI training crawler).

fields.label: Value
fields.hint: A whole number; that many dots are lit red.

fields.label: Total
fields.hint: A whole number; the chart draws one dot each, up to 400.

fields.label: What it counts
fields.default: news sites block at least one AI training crawler
fields.hint: Reads after “42 of 47”; up to three lines, about 60 characters.

fields.label: Source
fields.default: Massive, EDPB Web Scraping Guidelines: What the GDPR Draft Means for AI Data Collection
fields.hint: Who published it and where, after “Source:”.

fields.label: Source link
fields.hint: The page the number comes from, without https://.
